about: The collecta of the formulary “2nd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, O Lord, that we may always fear and love Your holy Name, for You never fail to guide those whom You firmly establish in Your love. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
